name: io.github.ibondarenko1/worldfuzz
title: WorldFuzz
description: Run bounded robotics tasks and read independently checked results in your workspace.

packageArguments.name: --placement
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to an existing version-1.0.0 local workspace placement. Use authority/token_env for organization access; root/store is for the trusted filesystem owner.

environmentVariables.name: WORLDFUZZ_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Existing scoped token for an organization placement using this token_env. Inject through the client's secret mechanism; omit for an owner-only local placement.
